articles.title: The Judge Dredd/Biker Mice From Mars Crossover Spawns an Epic Action Figure - NYCC 2026
articles.summary: 2026 has been packed full of strange and wonderful comic book crossovers, and perhaps none more strange than Judge Dredd/Biker Mice From Mars. Perhaps it's only fitting that the comic has now inspired an action figure.
body: This is quite an impressive pair. The Throttle figure features the iconic hero decked out in Dredd's armor. That figure is accompanied by a new vehicle that merges his trademark Martian Monster Bike with Dredd's Lawmaster. The figure includes plenty of other accessories, like an unmasked head and various weapons and interchangeable hands.

“It’s great to work with teams who share our love of both nostalgia and the future, so working with Nacelle and the legendary Biker Mice from Mars is right up our street,” said Jason Kingsley, CBE, co-founder and CEO of Rebellion, in a statement.

“Working with the wonderful folks at Rebellion on this comic and toy crossover has been one of the most delightful experiences in my career,” said Nacelle CEO Brian Volk-Weiss. “We’re excited to give fans an epic crossover event for these two beloved characters”.
Both the Throttle figure and the bike vehicle are available to preorder on the Nacelle website and Rebellion's site.
points: 2026 has been packed full of strange and wonderful comic book crossovers, and perhaps none more strange than Judge Dredd/Biker Mice From Mars.

articles.title: Strange Scaffold Saved This New Tactics Game From Cancellation
articles.summary: One of the more interesting game reveals from today's Triple-i Initiative showcase was Gods With Badges, a narrative-driven tactics game about a disgraced police officer returning to the line of duty.
body: The press release announcing Gods With Badges explained that the project began at Artificer, the Devolver Digital-owned studio behind games like Minos, Sumerian Six, and Showgunners. Originally called Hard Justice, the project ultimately didn't pan out and almost never saw the light of day.

Meanwhile, Strange Scaffold is spearheading an initative called Project Share, which encourages developers to share the original code for their games so other studios can riff on it. This previously helped enable the development of another Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion game and has now saved an Artificer game from cancellation.

The press release explains that Gods with Badges took the work already completed by Artificer and reinterpreted it "through Strange Scaffold's distinctive creative lens." Studio Head Xalavier Nelson Jr. added that he is "deeply grateful to the original developers at Artificer for trusting us with their project, and can't wait for people to see what we've built on this complex, exciting foundation."
points: One of the more interesting game reveals from today's Triple-i Initiative showcase was Gods With Badges, a narrative-driven tactics game about a disgraced police officer returning to the line of duty.

articles.title: The Beats Studio Pro Noise Canceling Headphones Drops to the Lowest Price Ever for Prime Day
articles.summary: Everyone's favorite high-end headphone is on sale for the lowest price ever for Prime Day. For a limited time, Walmart is offering the Beats Studio Pro wireless noise canceling headphones in white for just $119 with free shipping. That is a whopping 60% off the $300 list price.
body: The Studio Pro offers better audio quality than any other Beats headphone alongside excellent active noise cancelation. It carries over a lot of Apple's trademark features like spatial audio with head tracking, one touch pairing, and "Find My" functionality. It also has a Transparency mode so you can listen to the environment around you.

The Studio Pro also works well for Android smartphones. That's because it supports Android's most practical features like Google Fast Pair, Google Audio Switch, and Google Find My Device. Beats also has a mobile app for Android.

In wireless Bluetooth mode, the Studio Pro can last up to 40 hours on a single charge. The built in USB Type-C port supports fast charging but it can also be used as the connection method to your phone in wired mode, which is uncommon nowadays. Most other headphones require a 3.5mm output (which you can also do with the Studio Pro). The headphones fold in compactly and a soft carrying case is included for easy transport.
points: Everyone's favorite high-end headphone is on sale for the lowest price ever for Prime Day.

articles.title: Arc Raiders’ Big Update Has It Surging To Numbers It Hasn’t Seen In Months
articles.summary: When Embark said it would take several months to deliver the major Arc Raiders update it envisioned, days like today were probably the goal. The extraction shooter is once again high up in Steam's charts for both best-selling and most-played games.
body: Among best sellers, Arc Raiders currently ranks fifth, behind this week's other big releases, Star Wars: Galactic Racer and Gears of War: E-Day, but those came out earlier this week, and it's still early, so we may see it leap over those before the week is through. Its new cosmetic DLC, the Frozen Trail Collector's Set, is also selling very well. It currently sits at #8 on the best-sellers list.

As for concurrent players, Arc Raiders has eclipsed triple digits on Steam, something it hasn't done since May. It's sitting at 106,000--that's good for 12th on the list--and has actually gained 5,000 more players since I started writing this. Like its sales surge, it seems likely that it'll keep climbing throughout the day.

Not coincidentally, May was when Embark announced it would be moving to a semi-annual cadence for major updates, with today's Frozen Trail being the first such update since that change. Embark felt it needed more time to deliver bigger updates for players while giving developers breathing room for a healthier work environment.
points: When Embark said it would take several months to deliver the major Arc Raiders update it envisioned, days like today were probably the goal.

articles.title: 'Exploring Pendola Pass' quest walkthrough in Arc Raiders
articles.summary: The "Exploring Pendola Pass" quest in Arc Raiders is intended to be one of the first you tackle in the 'Frozen Trail' update, as it essentially acts as a whistlestop tour of some of the map's most notable points of interest.
body: Here's a full guide on how to complete "Exploring Pendola Pass" in Arc Raiders, including where to find the control room in Cielo Sereno Observatory and the tallest tower in the Railyard.

Destroying 20 Arc enemies is simple, if a little time-consuming, so we won't include a dedicated section for that one. I'd recommend using a long-range weapon, such as an Anvil or Renegade, to take out Wasps, Hornets, and Fireflies from afar, and steer clear of the new Bully enemy because it will absolutely ruin your day.

Make sure you have a wire on you when you visit the Railyard, and we recommend bringing a mobility gadget such as a grappling hook, snaphook, or zipline for both that task and the one at the observatory. Luckily, you receive three ziplines for accepting the quest, so make sure to bring them along.

The Cielo Sereno Observatory is located in the northeast corner of Pendola Pass. The quickest way to get to the control room (the location of which is shown in the image above) is to use a zipline, grappling hook, or snaphook to get on the roof. Otherwise, you can take the stairs underneath the building.

articles.title: Here Are The Highest-Grossing Resident Evil Movies Ever, And The New One Isn’t No. 1
articles.summary: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie got solid reviews and is making a lot of money at the box office, but where does it rank on the list of highest-grossing Resident Evil movies? It's not at the top, but it's pretty close. Director Paul W.S.
body: Director Paul W.S. Anderson made six previous Resident Evil movies, starring his wife, Milla Jovovich, and 2016's The Final Chapter currently ranks No. 1 in terms of money at the box office. Anderson's movies did not fare very well with critics, but had dedicated fans who kept going to see them. Together, Anderson's six movies made more than $1 billion.

Cregger's Resident Evil movie currently ranks No. 3 with about $250 million worldwide. It will need to add more than $60 million more to surpass The Final Chapter ($312 million worldwide). It's also still behind 2010's Resident Evil: Afterlife, which made about $300 million globally.

The new Resident Evil movie just came to China, and the franchise is very popular there. If it performs to expectation in China, the movie could reach $280 million soon to become Cregger's highest-grossing movie ever, surpassing Weapons.
points: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie got solid reviews and is making a lot of money at the box office, but where does it rank on the list of highest-grossing Resident Evil movies?

articles.title: Magic’s Most Versatile Mechanic Comes to Disney Lorcana With a Clever Twist
articles.summary: Disney Lorcana is about to introduce its own version in the game’s fourth year. When Hyperia City arrives at local game stores on Oct. 16 for prerelease events ahead of the wider Oct. 23 launch, ink drops will also arrive as a new way to ramp up ink generation.
body: Few Magic: The Gathering mechanics have become as ubiquitous as Treasure tokens. These artifacts can be sacrificed to generate one mana of any color, which means that, regardless of the deck’s colors or strategies, they can help cast more expensive cards ahead of schedule. Or you can stockpile them for a single explosive turn. Treasure tokens have become so common and popular since their debut in 2017’s Ixalan block that they're now less of a specialized mechanic and more a fundamental part of how modern Magic works.

Having gotten hands-on with various Hyperia City cards provided by Ravensburger, however, I realized ink drops are more than Treasure tokens with a Lorcana makeover. Hyperia City distributes them across all six ink types (but not evenly). The most interesting cards don’t just generate extra resources. They reward each color for producing and spending ink drops in its own particular way. In particular, Hyperia City really wants you to combine two of those strategies into a deck focused on cards featuring characters from 1963’s The Sword in the Stone.
points: Disney Lorcana is about to introduce its own version in the game’s fourth year.

articles.title: "It's clear that we both adore one another's games a lot" - Dave the Diver and Subnautica 2 team up for a crossover made in heaven
articles.summary: At today's Triple-i Showcase, Dave the Diver studio Mintrocket announced a surprisingly obvious, and perfectly fitting, collaboration. The game's final DLC, set for release in early 2027, brings the worlds of Subnautica 2 and Dave the Diver together.
body: Although the two games share deep-sea exploration as a mechanic, they're at opposite ends of the spectrum tonally - though they're still a better fit than many of the other brands Dave the Diver has crossed over with. These have included Balatro, Yakuza, Godzilla, and Guilty Gear to name a few.

The upcoming Subnautica 2 DLC is free and was developed in collaboration with Subnautica 2 team Unknown Worlds. It brings Subnautica 2's ocean moon of Proteus to Dave the Diver, and sees Dave and Bancho - having discovered all species of sea creatures and associated sushi recipes in this dimension - travel to a new dimension to uncover more.

While there, yes, they're going to run into Subnautica 2's iconic Leviathan, but also make new friends and hopefully return home having made a lot of new discoveries. Jaeho Hwang, Mintrocket studio director said: "Both games are set underwater, but Subnautica has such a distinct approach to underwater exploration, so working with the Subnautica 2 team gave us a chance to bring a new wave to Dave the Diver experience."

articles.title: 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary's Biggest TCG Release Is Already A Confirmed Nightmare
articles.summary: Dedicated Pokémon fans are eagerly awaiting pre-orders for the 30th Anniversary Trading Card Game's Ultra Premium Collection, the luxe release of the celebratory set that comes with a whopping 30 booster packs. Between the packs and the extensive accessories, no one expected the Nov.
body: Officially, the manufacturer's suggested retail price for the Ultra Premium Collection is $179.99. Savvy fans know that, unless they snag a pre-order from The Pokémon Center, they're unlikely to pay MSRP. GameStop has already shocked the world with its $399.99 UPC price tag, which is over 100% above MSRP.

Still, fans might've hoped that retailers like Target would at least be close to MSRP. According to influencers who have access to store page listings ahead of their official release, that won't be the case. Pokémon influencer BritBrattv — who has a track record for accurate Pokémon TCG retail news — says that Target's projected UPC price will be $249.99. The same figure has been reported by other major Pokémon restock Discord servers with access to store back-end listings.

We don't yet know what Walmart's pricing will be, but traditionally, the retailer's TCG prices are the same as Target's. Both retailers are stocked by third-party vendors such as Excell and MJ Holdings, and these are the largest influence on any given product's final retail price.

articles.title: Bobby Kotick returns: former Activision boss becomes board member of Skydance, the new company formed by Paramount and Warner Bros
articles.summary: Former Activision boss Bobby Kotick has returned to a position of high influence as a board member of Skydance, the new entertainment juggernaut formed by the merging of Warner Bros. into Paramount.
body: Kotick, who stepped down as Activision CEO following Xbox's $68.7bn acquisition of the company back in 2023, is joining the 13-person board alongside a selection of other newcomers. These include former UK prime minister Tony Blair, who is joining in an advisor role, and philanthropist Laurene Powell.

David Ellison, architect of the Warner Bros / Paramount merger, and Skydance's newly crowned CEO, issued the following statement: "I am delighted to welcome Laurene and Bobby to our Board and honored to have Tony join us as an Advisor. Bobby led a global entertainment company through three decades of sustained growth, and he brings real perspective on building enduring franchises and connecting with fans.

"His record of pairing bold strategic moves with disciplined capital allocation is exactly the experience we need as we bring our businesses together. Tony has led at the highest levels of government, respected for his intellect, strategic vision and ability to bring people together around bold, forward-looking ideas. His global perspective and insight will be invaluable as we turn ambition into results."

articles.title: Riot Games announces a final hurrah for its ill-fated fighting game 2XKO, with a surprise character joining the roster this month
articles.summary: Riot Games has released a final gameplay trailer for 2XKO, its short-lived fighting game set to be sunsetted later this year. The game is going out with a bang, with a shock reveal of a secret character coming alongside the games last major update.
body: This final major update, set to go live on the 27th October, was previously confirmed to feature Samira as the game's 16th character. This trailer features a showcase of her move set in action, however she shares the spotlight with Sett, a character who had been long requested from fans.

Sett, a bulky brawler, is seen to possess a combination of shattering blows and powerful grabs in this trailer. A significant difference between his 2XKO abilities and the kit available to him in League of Legends is a powered-up state which appears to intensify many of his special moves, granting them new and dangerous properties. One of his supers also appears to show him grabbing both characters on the enemy team at once, slamming them together in a homage to his MOBA manifestation.

The reception to this trailer is torn between excitement and understandable sadness. The trailer's top comment on YouTube, penned by user il3967, reads: "This is like watching a kid get visited by Spider-man at the hospital."
points: Riot Games has released a final gameplay trailer for 2XKO, its short-lived fighting game set to be sunsetted later this year.
